title: The Vivaldi Way Crispy Folded Egg & Bacon Breakfast Sando
originalTitle: The Vivaldi Way Crispy Folded Egg & Bacon Breakfast Sando
ingredients: 1 brioche bun or Kaiser roll, buttered and toasted
3 large eggs, whisked with a pinch of salt and black pepper
3 slices thick-cut bacon or crispy prosciutto cotto/sausage patty
2 slices sharp cheddar or Gruyère cheese
1 tbsp Calabrian chili mayo or spicy chipotle aioli
1 tbsp finely chopped chives & 1 tbsp butter
instructions: Crisp the bacon in a skillet, remove, and toast the buttered brioche bun in the pan until golden.
Pour the whisked eggs with chives into a buttered non-stick pan over medium-low heat, laying the cheese slices and bacon down the center.
Fold the edges of the egg envelope-style into a fluffy square packagethe size of the brioche bun.
Transfer the cheesy folded egg parcel onto the chili-mayo-slathered brioche bun and serve hot.
